h: Nigerian woman faces backlash for saying those who oppose Tinubu will face God's wrath
p: A woman identified as Tabitha Ogbede has reportedly drawn criticism online over a remark that anyone who opposes President Tinubu will face God's wrath. Reactions have been mixed, with some defending her and others saying the comment was out of order.
more: The clip has been widely shared on social media.
Supporters and critics of the President have both weighed in.
